feedback.correct: Six! You counted them all and added the one more — Momo trumpets with joy!
feedback.retry: Easy does it — Momo counts with you, slow and soft. Try again, no rush.

hint_sequence: Momo says it again, slowly: count the bananas one by one, then add one more.
Momo points with his trunk: touch each banana as you count — one… two… three…
Momo starts the counting for you: 'one… two… three…' Keep going, then say what comes after!

interactions.prompt: Tap each banana on the boat as you count, then tell Momo: how many bananas are there — 3, 5, or 7?
Plip! One more banana drops in. How many bananas are on the boat now — 5, 6, or 4?
At the dock, Simi the monkey has 4 oranges. One more orange rolls in. How many oranges — 3, 5, or 4?

objective: Count objects up to 10 and understand that adding one more makes the next number (5 → 6).
off_screen: At snack time, count the fruit on the table together — then add one more fruit and count again. What changed?
parent_note: Numbers: counting up to 10 and the 'one more' idea — adding one banana to five makes six, and the same trick works for oranges.

story_beats.art_note: Momo the lavender elephant in a wooden boat on a sunny river, five yellow bananas lined up on the deck.
story_beats.text: Momo the elephant is taking a banana boat down the river! Five bananas are already on board. Watch: Momo taps each one and counts — one, two, three, four, five!

story_beats.art_note: One extra banana falling from an overhanging branch; Momo's trunk raised, eyes wide with delight.
story_beats.text: Plip! One more banana drops in from a branch above. Now Momo counts again — one, two, three, four, five… six! Adding one more made five turn into six.

story_beats.art_note: Momo hands the counting job to the child; bananas glow softly, river sparkles.
story_beats.text: Now it is your turn, little captain! Help Momo count the bananas and add the one more.

story_beats.art_note: The boat reaches a wooden dock; Simi the monkey claps, Momo raises his trunk triumphantly.
story_beats.text: The boat reaches the banana dock. Simi the monkey claps: 'You know one more!' Momo trumpets: you are the river's finest captain!

subject: numbers
title: Momo's Banana Boat
transfer_question: Tomorrow, count three spoons at home. Add one more spoon — how many now? Tell a grown-up: 'One more made it four!'
